newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Brazil Ag Min sees record 96/97 soybean crop.
newsitem.headline: Brazil Ag Min sees record 96/97 soybean crop.

text.p: Brazil is expected to harvest a record soybean crop for 1996/97 of 26.4 million tonnes, said Agricultural Minister Arlindo Porto.

Porto told reporters the "record" soybean forecast was included in the latest crop estimate by the ministry's Agricultural Supply Company (Conab), which forecast a total grains and oilseeds crop of 81.185 million tonnes.
Porto said the "super-harvest" was expected to be 10.4 percent higher than in 1995/96.
He added that the soybean crop would be a record and noted that other independent institutes were predicting an even higher soybean harvest.
The estimates were included in Conab's third review of the crop and an updated estimate is expected in April.
